findings.title: SQL Injection Vulnerability
findings.description: User input is directly concatenated into SQL query without parameterization, allowing SQL injection attacks.
findings.code: const query = `SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ${req.params.id}`;
findings.recommendation: Use parameterized queries or an ORM. Never concatenate user input into SQL.

findings.title: Command Injection
findings.description: User-controlled data is passed to exec() without sanitization, allowing arbitrary command execution.
findings.recommendation: Use safe APIs that don't invoke shell. If shell is necessary, use allowlists for input validation.

findings.title: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
findings.description: User input rendered directly into HTML without encoding, allowing XSS attacks.
findings.recommendation: Use React's default escaping. Avoid dangerouslySetInnerHTML unless absolutely necessary and sanitize with DOMPurify.

findings.title: Hardcoded Cryptographic Key
findings.description: Encryption key is hardcoded in source code, compromising all encrypted data.
findings.recommendation: Store secrets in environment variables or a secure vault like Azure Key Vault.

findings.title: Insecure Random Number Generation
findings.description: Math.random() used for security-sensitive operations. This is not cryptographically secure.
findings.recommendation: Use crypto.randomBytes() for security-sensitive random values.

findings.title: Missing Input Validation
findings.description: Email input not validated before database insertion.
findings.recommendation: Implement server-side input validation using a library like validator.js or Zod.

findings.title: CVE-2023-26136: tough-cookie Prototype Pollution
findings.description: tough-cookie before 4.1.3 allows prototype pollution via malicious Cookie headers.
findings.recommendation: Update tough-cookie to version 4.1.3 or later: npm update tough-cookie

findings.title: CVE-2023-45857: axios SSRF Vulnerability
findings.description: axios before 1.6.0 allows SSRF via URL redirection.
findings.recommendation: Update axios to version 1.6.0 or later: npm update axios

findings.title: CVE-2024-28849: express Path Traversal
findings.description: express before 4.19.2 vulnerable to path traversal attacks.
findings.recommendation: Update express to version 4.19.2 or later: npm update express

findings.title: Outdated jsonwebtoken Library
findings.description: jsonwebtoken 8.5.1 is outdated. Multiple vulnerabilities fixed in newer versions.
findings.recommendation: Update jsonwebtoken to latest version: npm update jsonwebtoken

findings.title: Potential API Key Pattern
findings.description: String matching API key pattern found, but verified as false positive (test data).

findings.title: S3 Bucket Encryption Not Enforced
findings.description: S3 bucket does not enforce server-side encryption.
findings.recommendation: Add server_side_encryption_configuration block to enforce encryption.

findings.title: Security Group Too Permissive
findings.description: Security group allows inbound traffic from 0.0.0.0/0 on port 22.
findings.recommendation: Restrict SSH access to specific IP ranges or use Azure Bastion or private management access.

findings.title: Base Image Vulnerability: OpenSSL
findings.description: OpenSSL vulnerability CVE-2024-0727 in base image alpine:3.15.
findings.recommendation: Update base image to alpine:3.19 or later.

findings.title: Running as Root User
findings.description: Container runs as root user, violating least privilege principle.
findings.recommendation: Add USER directive to run as non-root: USER node

findings.title: Exposed Secrets in Environment Variables
findings.description: Environment variables contain sensitive data in Dockerfile.
findings.recommendation: Use Docker secrets or mount secrets at runtime instead of baking into image.
